Having seized part of Hsin's authority, Suhsin the Inevitable replicated Hsin's method for making Kernel Puppets and built one solely for war, the Soulfrayer.

Slender with a sleek design, it wanders the Heart of Frost to no purpose, a graceful figure receding into snowfall, seemingly indifferent to the world. But let one cross paths with an Autopuppet of Hsin's making, or a Celestial at work rebuilding the Civilization Capsule, and it will let loose arrows drawn from stagnant anomalies.

Contrast to the Formrender's violent design, though, the Soulfrayer is silent and sluggish. The two have never fought well together, a rift not even Suhsin the Inevitable has managed to close.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Soulfrayer |zhs = 绝息魄 |zht = 絕息魄 |ja = 息絶えの亡霊 |ko = 절식백 |fr = Écorchâme |de = Seelenschinder |es = Desgarralmas |th = Soulfrayer |pt = Desfia-Alma }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
